def _pypi_fetch(newest=None, upload="2026-10-21T10:00:00.000000Z"):
    newest = newest or {}

    def fetch(url):
        parts = url.rstrip("/").split("/")
        pkg = versions.normalize(parts[parts.index("pypi", 3) + 1]) if parts.count("pypi") > 1 else versions.normalize(parts[-2])
        base = versions.parse(SAMPLE)
        ver = newest.get(pkg) or base.packages.get(pkg) or base.cited.get(pkg) or "1.0"
        files = [{"upload_time_iso_8601": upload, "upload_time": upload.rstrip("Z").split(".")[0]}]
        return {"info": {"version": ver, "name": pkg}, "releases": {ver: files}, "urls": files}

    return fetch


def _pinned_resolver(calls, extra=None):
    base = versions.parse(SAMPLE)

    def resolver(reqs, python_version, cutoff):
        calls.append((list(reqs), python_version, cutoff))
        out = {versions.normalize(k): v for k, v in base.packages.items()}
        out.update(extra or {})
        return out

    return resolver

    subprocess.run(["git", "init", "-q"], cwd=root, check=True)
